relationships.subject: minocycline

relationships.subject: S-ketamine
relationships.evidence_quote: Intraperitoneal administration of 10 mg/kg S-ketamine significantly attenuated microglial reactivity in CCI mice as well as the inflammatory cytokines IL-1β and IL-6 (Fig. 6A–D).

relationships.subject: S-ketamine
relationships.evidence_quote: In contrast, 10 mg/kg S-ketamine significantly elevated the PWMT and PWTL values of CCI mice and maintained efficacy until day 14 (Fig. 5A,B).
